limitations: Local PostgreSQL 15.14; synthetic inline business payload 256 bytes, six small arrays, one GIN and four B-trees. Logged projection writes, not RLS/inheritance evaluation or revision retirement. Rate-limited 250K-row follow-up with a 256 KiB GIN pending-list limit, after the prior throttled run; cache, vacuum and array lengths differ, so this is not an isolated causal comparison; not a complete 10M rate-limited run. Three fixed read probes at up to 10 QPS each are not a 1000-user multi-tenant load test. Cluster WAL delta can include concurrent cluster maintenance and other app writes. No failover/replica or distributed admission benchmark.
